mentions.name: Mog
mentions.description: A markup language originally designed for a note-taking system, featuring first-class document structure and embedded data that give it capabilities Markdown requires extensions to match; the spec is in active development.
mentions.problem: Markdown requires extensions to match first-class document structure and embedded data.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Earlier this year, I started designing Mog, a markup language originally intended for my note-taking system.

As it's evolved, its strengths have come into focus. First-class document structure and embedded data give Mog capabilities that Markdown requires extensions to match.
mentions.author: bottd
